posts.title: 4.88 Billion Tokens for $120 — Why I Stopped Using Frontier Models for Everything
posts.description: Last month, I processed 4.88 billion tokens through an LLM. My bill: $120 . If I had run the same workload on a famous frontier model, the minimum estimate would have been $4,900 . On other frontier providers’ cheapest tiers: $4,880 . I didn’t save money by being cheap. I saved money by being intentional about which model does what.
